data.comment:
# Comfy Ideogram 4.5- Text to Image

Generate images from text prompts using Ideogram 4.5, with controls for canvas size, quality level, automatic prompt rewriting, and seed. No file inputs are required and one image is output. Ideal for typography-led posters, layout-driven design work, marketing visuals, and fast exploration of visual concepts.
 Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_ideogram_v4_5_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: A square 1:1 magazine poster cover in a refined classical art collage style. Background is warm ivory textured paper with subtle grain, speckles, and a vintage print feel. At the center stands a blindfolded classical Greek marble statue bust of a serene woman with softly waved hair and flowing draped fabric over her shoulders, rendered in a black-and-white halftone dot print effect with fine engraved-line detailing and high contrast. Behind her, two fainter mirrored marble goddess heads peek out from layered torn paper pieces in deep midnight navy and muted antique gold, with rough ripped edges and delicate dripping paint streaks that melt downward. The large, elegant high-contrast serif headline "Ideogram 4.5" dominates the top of the layout. "Ideogram" is set in charcoal black and "4.5" in metallic antique gold, with the statue's head slightly overlapping the letters to create depth. Above the headline, small centered serif text reads "HER VOICE WAS CARVED IN STONE / ONLY THE LIGHT REMEMBERS WHAT SHE SPOKE". A vertical gold caption on the left reads "A VISUAL ARTWORK", and a vertical caption on the right reads "DESIGNED BY IDEOGRAM 4.5". At the lower left, a navy block holds large cream serif text reading "ETERNAL MUSE". Small four-pointed gold star sparkles sit in the corners. The composition is balanced and symmetrical, like a museum exhibition poster, and evokes an editorial luxury magazine cover. The palette is ivory, charcoal, navy, and gold only, with no red tones. The mood is timeless, poetic, and artistic, with soft studio lighting, crisp typography, and high detail.
